\section[l'orario]{l'orario — opening hours, a timetable}

\label{lesson:IT-C139-lorario}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Italian for to foresee, then the Italian for to organise.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: l'orario}
\textbf{l'orario} — \textquotedblleft{}opening hours, a timetable\textquotedblright{}.

\emph{Read it:} the door — \textbf{Orario: lunedì – venerdì, 9 – 18.}

Open on weekdays from nine to six: not on \textbf{sabato}.

\section[(dialogue)]{The past and the future — a first pass}

\label{lesson:IT-R139-first-pass-the-past-and-the-future}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for a receipt and an appointment.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item \emph{Say it:} last, already, the day before yesterday, recently, to happen
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Last? (\textbf{scorso / scorsa}.) Already? (\textbf{già}.) The day before yesterday? (\textbf{l'altro ieri}.) Recently? (\textbf{recentemente}.) To happen? (\textbf{succedere}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[(dialogue)]{Reading notices — a second pass}

\label{lesson:IT-R139-second-pass-reading-notices}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for the future and this evening.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item the future, this evening, a plan, to foresee, to organise
  \item opening hours, a notice, the rent, a receipt, an appointment
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
The future? (\textbf{il futuro}.) This evening? (\textbf{stasera}.) A plan? (\textbf{il progetto}.) To foresee? (\textbf{prevedere}.) To organise? (\textbf{organizzare}.) Opening hours? (\textbf{l'orario}.) A notice? (\textbf{l'avviso}.) The rent? (\textbf{l'affitto}.) A receipt? (\textbf{la ricevuta}.) An appointment? (\textbf{l'appuntamento}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
